title: Replica restoration and promotion
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Promote a restored replica; reject missing committed boundaries or invalid ownership.
sourceAcceptance: Promotion requires the declared committed-data boundary and valid ownership; incomplete restoration cannot appear successful.
preconditions: A modern browser opens local HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no server or account.
Six fixed synthetic committed effects define authoritative boundary 6.
Candidate restored-s070 requires its own epoch-8 grant and the previous epoch-7 writer fenced.
Receipts, boundary authority, grants and fences are supplied fixtures, not database observations.
actions: Choose a boundary declaration, restoration receipts and ownership evidence.
Stage the restored candidate, then verify synchronization and writer eligibility.
Request promotion and inspect separate PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN results and exact missing effects.
Check a prediction without rewriting the actual promotion outcome.
Start a new attempt retaining proof, or explicitly reset all local memory.
assertions: Only declaration 6, every exact receipt through 6 and exclusive candidate-bound epoch-8 ownership permit promotion.
An interior missing receipt fails even when maximum receipt is 6.
Missing or stale boundary declarations and unfenced, stale or wrong-target ownership fail.
Unavailable receipts or ownership evidence produce UNKNOWN unless a known check fails.
Rejected or held promotion activates no restored writer and cannot count as completed migration.
Strict inputs, ordered transitions, immutable detached snapshots and six-attempt retained history are guarded.
Keyboard, error, reset and enforced CSP behavior are exercised in the actual DOM.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral RED and before implementation

testRuntime.purpose: Existing Node22 test tooling only; not production Node24 certification.

limits: Deterministic synthetic data only; no actual database restore, replication, promotion, fencing or ownership certification.
No native Azure, real user-journey, latency, concurrency, durability or uninterrupted-service proof.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, deployment, expenditure or production Node24 validation.
The reference journal retaining data does not establish a completed promotion.
History lives only in browser memory; reset or reload clears it.
B-S070 and source parent D-S070 native acceptance remain incomplete.
The abandoned browser lifecycle prototype is unqualified; no unattended-runner certification.
One frozen S unit; tests, evidence, tooling and refinement earn no additional units.
